title.zh: 假如 Opus 5.5 遇上中式美学

intro.en: A circular window where sunrise, ink, cells, celadon, and the shared curves of a bridge, an eave, a jade bi, a round fan, a moon gate and a bronze mirror turn into one another. Drag the arc.
intro.zh: 一扇圆窗里，日出、水墨、细胞、青瓷，以及拱桥、飞檐、玉璧、团扇、月洞门与铜镜共用同一条弧，彼此化生。抚动这一弧即可穿行。
